# Floorplan Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor: Draw a plain-language interactive map of your app, where every subsystem, module, file and HTTP route gets a human name and a one-line description, connected by imports and calls. It adds a health check, a guided tour and a blueprint mode that plans an app from a PRD before any code exists.

The first run scans the codebase, then the agent writes architecture.json and one-line descriptions for every file and route, builds the map, and shows it in the browser, with recent work highlighted and a tour for newcomers. The map is saved as a self-contained floorplan/index.html and stays out of git, since floorplan/ carries its own ignore file. Honest limits: the health check is a quick automatic check, not a security audit; secrets are masked and never repeated; the Ask bar needs the Claude Code CLI or Codex, otherwise the map still opens without questions; and the map only shows the kinds of file it names, so a small map is not proof that nothing was missed. By @haydenschmitty, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via GitHub. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
